summary: This bill expands Medicare coverage to include external infusion pumps and certain non-self-administrable home infusion drugs, provided specific criteria related to administration, professional supervision, and frequency of infusion are met.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands Medicare coverage to include external infusion pumps and non-self-administrable home infusion drugs. This directly increases the scope of public healthcare services provided under Medicare, making it more accessible for certain patients.
The bill expands Medicare coverage for external infusion pumps and home infusion drugs without any offsets or spending reductions, which would increase federal outlays under the program.
The core purpose of the bill is to expand Medicare coverage for home infusion therapy, directly constituting government action to broaden access and reduce patient costs for these services.
